title: Optimal location of small favourable regions for Robin eigenvalues with indefinite weights
summary: We consider the positive principal eigenvalue of an elliptic problem with a Robin boundary condition and bang--bang indefinite weight $κ\mathbf 1_D-\mathbf 1_{Ω\setminus D}$, and ask where a favourable region $D$ of prescribed small volume $|D|=δ$ should be located. Put $\varepsilon=δ^{1/N}$ and $τ_δ=α_δ\varepsilon$.
